disclosures.title_en: Operations and suppliers at significant risk for incidents of child labor
disclosures.title_vi: Operations and suppliers at significant risk for incidents of child labor

requirements.description_en: Clause a: Operations and suppliers considered to have significant risk for incidents of: - i. child labor; - ii. young workers exposed to hazardous work.
requirements.description_vi: Tổ chức báo cáo thông tin chi tiết về: Operations and suppliers considered to have significant risk for incidents of: - i. child labor; - ii. young workers exposed to hazardous work.

requirements.description_en: Clause b: Operations and suppliers considered to have significant risk for incidents of child labor either in terms of: - i. type of operation (such as manufacturing plant) and supplier; - ii. countries or geographic areas with operations and suppliers considered at risk.
requirements.description_vi: Tổ chức báo cáo thông tin chi tiết về: Operations and suppliers considered to have significant risk for incidents of child labor either in terms of: - i. type of operation (such as manufacturing plant) and supplier; - ii. countries or geographic areas with operations and suppliers considered at risk.

requirements.description_en: Clause c: Measures taken by the organization in the reporting period intended to contribute to the effective abolition of child labor.
requirements.description_vi: Tổ chức báo cáo thông tin chi tiết về: Measures taken by the organization in the reporting period intended to contribute to the effective abolition of child labor.

disclosures.recommendations_en: Follow GRI technical compilation recommendations for Disclosure 408-1.
disclosures.recommendations_vi: Tuân thủ các khuyến nghị kỹ thuật và phương pháp luận tổng hợp dữ liệu cho Chỉ số 408-1.
